body:
AI-authored continuation (founder: next episode). Stillness Council makes real direct contact for the first time in NEVER_LAND via the page-delivered-by-a-clerk mechanism already established in s00e-1_the_determination.md. A new character, a Clerk, delivers one page: WHO WITNESSED THE WITNESS? Hana, the Archivist, and the Owl each offer a partial answer; Tyler names the honest through-line: it's witnesses all the way down and an empty room at the bottom. A second page suspends the Man's E4 protocol review pending a witness with the authority to matter. Files: episodes/nl05_durations_are_data.md, EPISODES.md, activity.md, CHANGELOG.md.
